firstRun.title: Welcome to Porto
firstRun.description: Create the owner account. You set up the marina right after.
firstRun.name: Your name
firstRun.updateCheck: Check for updates (only the version number, no marina data)
firstRun.restoreDescription: Already used Porto on another computer or a server? Restore its backup: you also need its secret key.

settings.title: Desktop app
settings.description: Local network, backups, updates and secret key of this computer.
settings.openWarning: Phones and other computers work only while this app is open.
settings.onlyInApp: These settings are available only in the desktop app window, on the computer where it is installed.

lan.title: Local network
lan.description: Lets the other office computers and the phones on the marina Wi-Fi use Porto.
lan.off: The local network is off: no other device can connect.
lan.rotateConfirm: Connected phones and computers will see the certificate warning again: pair them again if they cannot connect.
lan.rotateAllConfirm: Also regenerates the local authority: every device must accept the certificate again.

backup.title: Backups
backup.description: One backup a day and one every time the app closes.
backup.restoreConfirm: A backup of the current data is taken before restoring. After the restore everybody logs in again.
backup.fallback: The chosen folder is not available: backups go to the data folder.
backup.folderHint: Leave empty to use the data folder. You can choose a USB stick or a shared folder.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Porto checks once a day whether a new version exists: it sends only the version number and the operating system. It never downloads or installs anything by itself.

secret.title: Secret key
secret.description: Needed to restore the backups on another computer or a server. Keep it somewhere safe.
secret.warning: Whoever has the key and a backup can read all the data: do not share it.
secret.fileFallback: The system keychain is not available: the key is stored in a file in the data folder.

data.title: Data
data.description: Where Porto keeps the database, the files and the logs on this computer.

localMode.title: Not available in the desktop edition
localMode.publicPage: The public marina page cannot be reached from the internet.
localMode.onlinePayments: Online payments and payment links need a server reachable from the internet.
localMode.remoteSignature: Remote signature with a code sent to the customer needs a server reachable from the internet.
localMode.learnMore: How to move to an online server
localMode.paymentLinks: Payment links cannot be reached by customers: this computer is not reachable from the internet.
localMode.cardTitle: You are using Porto on your computer
localMode.cardDescription: Everything works without internet. The public page, online payments and remote signature need an online server instead.

online.title: Moving to an online server
online.description: The desktop edition works without internet. The public page, online payments and remote signature need an online Porto server.
online.noSync: The two do not synchronise: everything moves to the server and you carry on there.
online.unavailableTitle: What the desktop edition cannot do
online.why: This computer is not reachable from the internet: customers and payment providers cannot contact it.
online.stepsTitle: How to move to an online server

steps.backup: Take a backup now from the desktop edition.
steps.secret: Show the secret key and keep it somewhere safe: without the key the backup cannot be read.
steps.server: On the Porto server restore the backup with the key, then start porto serve with an https address (PORTO_BASE_URL).
steps.pair: Pair phones and workstations with the server again.
steps.stop: Stop using the desktop copy: the two do not synchronise.

pair.title: Connect this device
pair.invalid: Code expired or already used: ask for a new QR.
pair.network: This device cannot reach Porto: check you are on the marina Wi-Fi and accept the certificate warning.
pair.description: Connect this phone or computer to Porto.
pair.fingerprintHint: It must match the one shown on the office computer.
pair.totpHint: Your account uses two-step verification: enter the code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.

restore.title: Restore in progress
restore.description: Porto restarts on the backup data. When it is done, sign in again with an account that is in the backup.

remote.pinHint: 6 to 12 digits, used for the settings of this computer.
remote.updateApp: The online Porto runs a different version: update the app.
remote.description: Use this computer as a workstation of an online Porto: the data stays on the server.
remote.linkHint: Paste the link copied from the Devices page of the online Porto, or enter address and code.
remote.name: Name of this workstation
remote.pinMismatchDetail: The server presented an unexpected certificate. Expected fingerprint: {{expected}}. Received fingerprint: {{presented}}.
remote.title: Online Porto
remote.unreachableHint: The online Porto does not answer: you can go on with the operations allowed offline, which are sent when the connection is back.
remote.unpairDescription: The device is revoked on the online Porto and this computer goes back to the first setup.
remote.revokedDescription: This computer was disconnected from the online Porto. Connect it again or use Porto locally.
remote.copied: Link copied: paste it into the desktop app to connect.
remote.fromFirstRun: Already have an online Porto? Connect this computer

peripherals.title: Peripherals
peripherals.label: Label printer
peripherals.description: Printers, QR reader and fiscal printer connected to this computer.
peripherals.readerHint: USB readers type like a keyboard: they work without a driver.
peripherals.fiscalHint: Real fiscal printer models are extensions: without one, commercial documents stay pending.

kiosk.title: Kiosk mode
kiosk.exitHint: Enter the app PIN (in local mode: email and password of an owner).
kiosk.description: The window fills the screen, without menus or task bar: suited to the front desk.
kiosk.saved: Setting saved: it applies from the next start.
kiosk.active: The window is in kiosk mode.
kiosk.done: Kiosk mode off until the next start.

pin.title: App PIN
pin.description: Enter the PIN set when this computer was connected.
pin.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.

lanCa.regenerate: To offer the certificate to phones, use “Regenerate all” first.
